title: Harden Atelier panel mock-server tests under load
origin: MT-044 D4 split: read_http_request mock-server helpers use tight timeouts and expect paths that can panic under heavy cargo load.

scope.summary: Harden the test_atelier_panel mock-server request readers so expected requests fail with useful diagnostics instead of flaky timeout panics under heavy parallel machine load.
base_scope: Harden the test_atelier_panel mock-server request readers so expected requests fail with useful diagnostics instead of flaky timeout panics under heavy parallel machine load.
acceptance_criteria: Mock-server request readers avoid brittle 500ms timeout panics under normal heavy-load test execution.
Expected-route failures produce actionable diagnostics without hiding real product regressions.
Contact-sheet and Facial backend-export tests can run serially without mock-server flake.

Risk: swallowing mock read errors hides backend request regressions.

No foreground process launch or external process kill.

handoff.note: MT-048 is ready for validator review. This is not official validation; validator_verdict remains PENDING. Mock-server request readers now distinguish idle sockets from partial requests, expected export routes fail with captured-route diagnostics, CKC byte-fetch routes are served by the CKC mock instead of being allowlisted while returning 404, and the blocked Facial review export test asserts its expected route directly.
implementation_summary: Raised shared mock read tolerance with MOCK_SERVER_READ_TIMEOUT=5s while retaining bounded accept/read waits for heavy-load execution.
Hardened read_http_request so partial bytes become an INCOMPLETE_HTTP_REQUEST diagnostic request instead of a swallowed idle connection or a brittle panic.
Changed spawn_posekit_export_server to require an expected request line, ignore only GET /atelier/preferences, and return a diagnostic 404 for wrong non-preferences routes.
Moved CKC request capture before handler dispatch so unexpected routes remain visible even when the handler returns an error.
Closed the post-review CKC drift gap by serving real PNG bytes for GET /atelier/media-assets/*/bytes whenever that route is classified as expected.
Added a direct route assertion to facial_review_blocked_command_status_line_is_honest_not_succeeded so the blocked review test fails at the route boundary if dispatch drifts.
proof_results: ckc_linked_media_backend_roundtrip_reaches_argus: 1 passed, 0 failed; proves the shared CKC mock route allow-list including the byte-fetch route after the post-review fix.
facial_review_blocked_command_status_line_is_honest_not_succeeded: 1 passed, 0 failed; proves the new direct blocked-review route assertion.
git diff --check exit 0 with LF-to-CRLF warning only on src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/test_atelier_panel.rs.
post_review_resolution: Pre/post-review confirmed the Posekit export helper now preserves expected-route diagnostics under preferences noise and partial reads.

Post-review medium finding: CKC route assertions could classify GET /atelier/media-assets/*/bytes as expected while handle_ckc_roundtrip_request returned 404. Resolution: CKC mock server now detects that request line and writes a real image/png byte response before JSON handler dispatch.

Post-review low finding: facial_review_blocked_command_status_line_is_honest_not_succeeded discarded its captured request. Resolution: the test now asserts POST /atelier/intake/batches/batch-1/facial/review/session directly.
